# Copilot Instructions

Before writing any UI code, load the `les-mills-design-system` skill.

Before creating, refactoring, or reviewing any UI component, load the `les-mills-component-library` skill.

## Project tooling
flows: gen-e2          # local .gen-e2.flow files under docs/<feature>/
wireframes: figma      # Figma is the design source of truth; gen-e2 .wf used for planning when no Figma frame exists
stories: gen-e2        # local .gen-e2.story.md files under docs/<feature>/

Planning artefacts live in `docs/<feature-name>/`.
